entities.summary: Selwyn Image was a British artist, designer, writer and poet associated with the Arts and Crafts Movement. He designed stained glass windows, furniture and embroidery, and illustrated books. He was the seventh Slade Professor of Fine Art at the University of Oxford from 1910 to 1916. Selwyn Image was a painters & sculptors from Bodiam (1849-02-17, Bodiam–1930-08-21). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
